name: ECC
description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
one_liner: A toolkit that upgrades AI coding assistants like Claude Code or Cursor with better memory, skills, and security so they make fewer mistakes on real projects.
buyer: An engineering manager at a software agency whose team mixes junior developers with AI coding agents and needs the AI to behave consistently.
business_use_cases: A dev agency standardizes every client project on this 'agent operating system' to make AI-assisted coding consistent and safer across the team.
A SaaS startup uses it to run AI coding agents unattended overnight with guardrails, cutting engineering costs.
An AI-tooling consultancy sells 'agent harness setup' as an onboarding package for companies adopting Claude Code or Cursor at scale.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid one-day 'AI coding agent audit and hardening' service for client dev teams.
Sell curated, vetted skill packs on top of the base toolkit.

steal_this: Offer a paid 'install and tune this for your team in a day' service to any small dev shop already using Claude Code or Cursor.
